ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Technical spike (0.2.0-alpha.2). Ordered-work framework that orders work types and work givers, splits a work type into a new one, and merges givers into an existing work type. It never deletes work types or givers. Split work types copy work tags, skills, life-stage availability and mech availability, so traits and incapacities keep working. This build adds a pure Core dense-rank library, a console test harness, and a Mod Settings test button that writes dense rank 1..N to free colonists and logs the result. There is no visual Work Control UI yet; the dense-rank test only logs. Changes apply on restart. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
